description: This Java source file defines the IndexInitializer class responsible for initializing and managing indexes on a MongoDB collection using reactive streams and Akka Streams. It includes methods for creating, dropping, and validating indices based on provided configurations.

classes.name: IndexInitializer
classes.description: A final class responsible for initializing and managing MongoDB indexes with support for creating, dropping, and verifying indices asynchronously.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an IndexInitializer instance with specified MongoDatabase and Materializer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Main method to initialize specified indices and remove undefined ones on a given collection.

methods.name: createNonExistingIndices
methods.description: Creates indices that do not already exist on the collection.

methods.name: createIndices
methods.description: Creates multiple indices on the collection.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates a single index on the collection.

methods.name: dropUndefinedIndices
methods.description: Drops indices that are not defined in the provided list.

methods.name: getUndefinedIndexNames
methods.description: Returns names of indices that are present but not defined.

methods.name: dropIndices
methods.description: Drops a list of indices by name.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops a single index by name.

methods.name: getIndicesExceptDefaultIndex
methods.description: Retrieves existing indices excluding the default '_id_' index.

methods.name: extractIndexNames
methods.description: Retrieves a set of index names from a collection of Index objects.

methods.name: excludeIndices
methods.description: Filters out indices that are specified to be excluded based on their names.
